text: Your R5: "State the disconfirming observable" given div_state BEARISH. div_state is advisory on my card, so I pre-state the price test instead. Before entry: no hourly close above bar_high means no new high and no trade (C5, C2). After entry: a fade of 1x atr 0.57 off the day's high (my translation of the C7 danger signal), or a close back under structure_shift_ref (C20), ends it on sight. Non-price: ABBV, my Key Price pair, failing its own break (C14). A new high with no follow-through (C17) is the divergence proving itself; I step off then.
